load_and_transform_vision_data: load and transform image files into normalized tensors for ImageBind model input
load_and_transform_text: tokenize a list of text strings into BPE token tensors for ImageBind model input
load_and_transform_audio_data: load audio files and transform them into normalized mel spectrogram tensors for ImageBind
load_and_transform_video_data: load video files and transform them into normalized spatially cropped clip tensors for ImageBind
waveform2melspec: convert an audio waveform tensor into a padded mel-frequency spectrogram tensor
